_about: Per-user settings for show-dont-tell. Copy to ~/.config/show-dont-tell/config.json and edit. Names here are what the round report prints; the agent never guesses them. Where images are saved and Eagle live in each project's show-dont-tell.json (template: project.example.json).

lead.name: <model that plans and writes prompts>
lead.harness: <agent app, e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity>

worker.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
worker.brief_guide: <optional path to your own notes on briefing the worker>

image.note: uses the ChatGPT app's own sign-in; has usage limits, not for bulk. Change route/script to use another provider.
